biomatter-2026.tagline: Biotech startup designing industrial enzymes on demand with AI

founders.background: From Vilnius University Life Sciences Center. Researcher in biochemistry and structural biology. Published ProteinGAN research in Nature Machine Intelligence in 2021.
founders.notable_achievement: Pioneer of AI-based protein generation technology that designs new enzyme reactions not found in nature

biomatter-2026.team_highlights: Team of 37, mostly based in Vilnius, Lithuania. In January 2026, became the first Baltic company to join AstraZeneca BioVentureHub (Sweden), and concurrently conducts therapeutic protein design research.

product.summary: Unlike traditional methods that modify natural enzymes, the customer inputs their desired chemical reaction (customer's target reaction), and the AI designs a new enzyme with an optimized amino acid sequence from scratch (de novo design) for the reaction conditions.
product.problem_statement: Traditional enzyme engineering starts from natural enzymes and improves them, so if the desired reaction does not exist in nature or existing enzymes are unsuitable, development takes months to years and has low success rates.
product.solution: Biomatter's 'Intelligent Architecture' platform generates tens to hundreds of thousands of design candidates based on input reaction conditions (temperature, pH, substrate, etc.). It validates them with models trained on proprietary experimental data (including enzymes not found in nature), then synthesizes and tests the most promising candidates. The entire process is completed within weeks.
key_features: Capable of designing completely new enzymes with low sequence similarity to natural enzymes (106 amino acid difference) (validated in 2021 Nature Machine Intelligence paper)
Designed an enzyme (Methylase) for mRNA vaccine manufacturing that does not require expensive SAM (S-adenosylmethionine), which natural enzymes need.

Improved Thermo Fisher Scientific's SuperScript V reverse transcriptase: achieved oxidation resistance allowing storage at room temperature for 6 months (enabling room temperature distribution and storage)
product.tech_stack_or_innovation: Generative AI (ProteinGAN family) combined with proprietary experimental data from non-natural enzymes, forming an 'experiment-data-model' feedback loop. Core competitive edge is not the algorithm but years of accumulated experimental data and a validated design-synthesis-test cycle.
product.target_customer: Global companies needing custom enzymes for specific chemical reactions, including pharma/biotech (AstraZeneca, Sanofi, Thermo Fisher), diagnostics (Neogen), industrial biotech (BASF, Tereos), and food (Kirin). Currently delivering over 50 custom enzymes to more than 25 companies.
product.business_model: Project-based contracts charging for custom enzyme design and development (potentially including royalties/fees). Clients incorporate the designed enzymes into their products or processes.

direct_competitors.name: Cradle (Amsterdam)
direct_competitors.comparison: AI-based protein design. Collaborates with pharma companies (Bayer, etc.), focuses on antibody development. Biomatter focuses more on industrial enzymes and has its own synthesis and testing facilities.

direct_competitors.name: OpenProtein.AI (Singapore)
direct_competitors.comparison: AI protein design SaaS. Biomatter offers a one-stop service from design to synthesis and testing, not just SaaS.

direct_competitors.name: AI Proteins (Boston)
direct_competitors.comparison: Novel protein design. Has its own testing facilities. Focus on therapeutic proteins.

direct_competitors.name: Cyrus Biotechnology (Seattle)
direct_competitors.comparison: Protein design software. More of a platform licensing model compared to Biomatter.

competitive_landscape.key_differentiator: Specialization in 'starting from chemical reaction (de novo) design' rather than simple AI prediction models, and integrated capability to directly validate predictions through experiments at its own 2,000m² design-and-test facility currently under construction.
competitive_landscape.moat: Proprietary experimental dataset of enzymes with sequences significantly different from natural enzymes, and 8 years of experience building the design-synthesis-test cycle. It would take years for new entrants to acquire and validate this data.
competitive_landscape.competitive_position_summary: A leader in custom industrial enzyme design with the most validated achievements (integration into Thermo Fisher products, SAM-free enzyme development). One of the few European AI protein design startups with its own experimental facilities.

product.summary: Infino is a unified retrieval layer that allows AI agents to handle full-text search, vector search, and SQL aggregation with a single query. product.solution: Infino integrates BM25 full-text search, vector (kNN) search, and SQL aggregation into a single engine. The engine connects directly to agents via MCP and includes a small inference model to handle simple reasoning tasks inexpensively.

product.summary: Denta is a model where companies cover their employees' dental costs directly without an insurer. Employers set an annual benefit limit, employees receive a discount at participating dental clinics and pay with a Denta debit card, and AI processes claims in real time. Instead of the industry inefficiency where only 60% of premiums go to care, almost all of the company's spending goes toward treatment.
product.problem_statement: The U.S. dental insurance market has an annual limit of $1,500 as the industry standard, and it is so inefficient that only 60 cents per dollar of premium is paid out as care. Claims processing also takes weeks and is paid by paper checks.
product.solution: Denta enables companies to operate dental benefits for employees with their own funds. Employers set an annual benefit limit, employees pay with a Denta card after a dental visit, and Denta reviews and pays claims immediately with AI, without an insurance intermediary. It further lowers costs by applying discounts from the participating dental network.
key_features: Employee-only Denta debit card
AI-powered real-time claims processing (approval in seconds)
Pre-negotiated discounts at participating dental clinics
Easy enrollment via payroll system integration
No additional membership or enrollment fees, only charged for actual usage

product.business_model: Employers choose an annual benefit limit per employee (e.g., $1,000-2,000) and only pay for actual treatment usage, while Denta charges a 5% transaction fee. No monthly subscription or maintenance fees.
